sentences.en: Mina runs back to the house.
sentences.fa: مینا دوباره به سمت خانه می‌دود.

sentences.en: "Mom!" she says.
Mom is in the kitchen.
Dad is in the kitchen.
"Where is Nino?" Mina says quickly.
Nino is not at home.
"We look for Nino together," Mom says.
sentences.fa: «همه با هم دنبال نینو می‌گردیم»، مامان می‌گوید.

sentences.en: Dad looks in the rooms.
Her brother looks in his room.
sentences.fa: برادرش به اتاق خودش نگاه می‌کند.

sentences.en: "Our little cat is black," he says.
sentences.fa: گربه‌ی کوچک ما سیاه است، او می‌گوید.

sentences.en: Her sister is a baby.
The baby is in her room.
Her little sister is still in the room.
sentences.fa: خواهر کوچکش هنوز در اتاق است.

sentences.en: "Nino! Nino!" Mina calls through the house.
sentences.fa: «نینو! نینو!» مینا در خانه صدایش می‌کند.

sentences.en: The family looks and looks.
sentences.fa: خانواده نگاه می‌کنند و نگاه می‌کنند.

sentences.en: The family looks for Nino.
"We do not see Nino," Dad says at last.
sentences.fa: «نینو را نمی‌بینیم»، بابا در پایان می‌گوید.

sentences.en: "He is my cat," Mina says.
sentences.fa: او گربه‌ی من است، مینا می‌گوید.

sentences.en: "And he is our cat," her brother says.
sentences.fa: «و او گربه‌ی ما هم هست»، برادرش می‌گوید.

sentences.en: Mom and Dad are her parents.
sentences.fa: مامان و بابا پدر و مادرش هستند.

sentences.en: Her parents look and look.
sentences.fa: پدر و مادرش نگاه می‌کنند و نگاه می‌کنند.

sentences.en: They live in the house.
They look in the house, and they look at the door.
sentences.fa: آن‌ها به خانه نگاه می‌کنند، و به در نگاه می‌کنند.

sentences.en: The family lives in the house.
"Our house is our home, and Nino knows it," Mom says.
sentences.fa: «خانه‌ی ما خانه‌ی نینو هم هست و او آن را می‌شناسد»، مامان می‌گوید.

sentences.en: Mom and Dad have two daughters and a son.
sentences.fa: مامان و بابا دو دختر و یک پسر دارند.

sentences.en: The daughter is Mina.
The son is her brother.
"Look at me," Mina says to the bird.
sentences.fa: «به من نگاه کن»، مینا به پرنده می‌گوید.

sentences.en: The red bird looks back at Mina.
sentences.fa: پرنده‌ی قرمز دوباره به مینا نگاه می‌کند.

sentences.en: "Where is my cat?" Mina says again.
Mina goes to the door.
Nino is not at the door.
"Where did he go?" Mom says.
"He ran after the bird," Mina says.
"Come home, Nino!" Mina calls.
Come home! Come home!
Mina looks at the window.
Nino is not at the window.
